scope: bounded exact-export Debian 13 ARM64 container image and ordinary one-shot Compose runtime foundation
acceptance_limit: Independent acceptance is limited to one exact-export native ARM64 image and a fresh empty synthetic Compose runtime with retained independently inspectable evidence. It does not prove image-byte reproducibility, a pristine first-attempt TLS launch, clean-host package lifecycle, upgrade, rollback, backup/restore, failed-candidate handling, removal, companion admission, F1, F6, or F7.

archive.format: git archive tar with source/ prefix

source.staging_calibration: An initial guest staging assertion used the prior commit's stale expected count 774 and stopped after the host/guest manifest equality check. The current archive was then derived and verified as 780 members before the sole build; no source or artifact was changed.

immutable_inputs.runtime_ca_source: copied from the digest-pinned builder stage

build.command: DOCKER_BUILDKIT=0 docker build --platform linux/arm64 --build-arg TESLATLAS_HUB_SOURCE_COMMIT=<exact-commit> -t teslatlas-hub:f6-arm64-4102dce-r2 -t teslatlas-hub:local .
network_boundary: Docker Hub access for exact digest-pinned official Rust and Debian bases
crates.io access for Cargo.lock/checksum-bound registry metadata and crates in the builder stage
no runtime-stage network or package-manager command
not_claimed: registry manifest digest for this local image

compose_runtime.tls_material: fresh one-use local CA and DNS-only server certificate; key bytes were never retained and all one-use material was purged

tls_input_correction.cause: The fresh test server certificate and key were initially staged root-owned with 0640, which did not meet Hub's no-follow same-UID private-key predicate.
tls_input_correction.claim_limit: The same Compose cohort recovered and became healthy after correcting only the one-use test input. This is not a pristine first-attempt startup claim.

compose_runtime.doctor_before_restart: all eight named checks passed; schema 59; SQLite 3.53.2; zero vehicles, observations and token rows; TLS identity valid; collector init-only and ready
compose_runtime.status_before_restart: status ok; no credentials or vehicles; ready=false with collector_absent, as expected for init-only synthetic setup
compose_runtime.synthetic_scope: production init plus health/doctor/status readback against a fresh empty store; no credentials, account, vehicle, import, companion, private input or production endpoint

prepare_attempts.reason: Raw doctor detail text contained privateKey=true and was rejected by the published scanner.
prepare_attempts.closure: The runtime command remained teslatlas-hub doctor --format json. The runner produced a structured jq derivative retaining status, schema, named check IDs and pass flags, non-secret catalogue/collector/credential-state/safety/stream/TLS booleans, vehicles and version while deleting every free-text check detail. Raw doctor output, its hash and the exact jq program were not retained, so the transformation is runner-reported rather than independently reproducible; only the resulting allowlisted derivative is independently inspectable.

prepare_attempts.reason: Restart metadata used secret-shaped field names for certificate/key stat strings.
prepare_attempts.closure: Only the metadata fields were renamed to corrected_key_file_stat and corrected_certificate_file_stat; the exact non-secret stat strings were preserved and no source/runtime evidence changed.

evidence.finalization: Cleanup began only after READY_FOR_CLEANUP. The cohort-bound cleanup receipt was added by the published finalizer, which rechecked every prepared file and emitted COMPLETE. After independent review found the image-scope wording ambiguous, cleanup.json gained only an exact scope/classification for the already-recorded final-image removal and retained anonymous builder intermediate; its file record, COMPLETE aggregate and manifest hash were recomputed. No runtime assertion changed.

timeline_and_lock.lock_shell_recovery: The first holder shell PID 53820 exited after a nonzero guest command under set -e. Its absence and exact owner record were verified, the owned stale lock was removed, and no second heavy job was started.

cleanup.cleanup_field_semantics: The evidence harness cleanup.json field owned_images_removed is bound to the cohort image_id and its two runtime tags. That exact final runtime image and both tags were removed. It does not assert pruning anonymous legacy-builder ancestors or the Docker build cache, which were intentionally retained and disclosed below.

remaining: A second clean export build for image-byte reproducibility, if that is required by the final F6 claim.
Container upgrade, rollback, backup/restore, failed candidate and data-preserving removal.
Clean-host Debian and macOS lifecycle closure, exact populated five-companion catalog, combined installed ecosystem, F1, F6 and F7.
F5 fresh separately authorized real inputs.

findings: P2 cleanup image wording appeared to contradict the disclosed retained untagged legacy-builder intermediate
P2 deterministic jq doctor-redaction claim was not independently reproducible because the exact filter and raw-input hashes were not retained

reviews.verified: Cleanup is bounded to the named/tagged cohort and runnable final image ID while the anonymous builder intermediate remains disclosed; doctor transformation is runner-reported and explicitly non-reproducible; cleanup SHA e7d4c3c8272820da6bd7ec4b86a9e9e6a817c8ca406a32b11b03199a6eb2a2d7, COMPLETE aggregate ec3ad4ff24ea801e414eeb1f0f1f725cf09a40ffa789a858a621cd15366c382e, manifest SHA 1d44e746942ee4652bb1c2310a4c9d72a252daad3e2d66dbd44e379a554fbe88 and 25 files recompute cleanly.

independent_review.verified_without_findings: Live remote/local/origin identity; exact source archive/tree/780-member manifest; COMPLETE 25-file manifest and aggregate; image/config/source/version; generic Compose initializer ordering; volume/sentinel modes; TLS retry calibration and corrected stat names; health/status/security/restart; cohort-bound cleanup.
independent_review.acceptance_limit: Accepted only as the bounded exact-export ARM64 container runtime foundation. Image-byte reproducibility, pristine first-attempt TLS startup, upgrade/rollback, backup/restore, failed candidate, removal, full clean-host lifecycle, F1, F6 and F7 remain open.
